basics.name: Jane Doe
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary:
Backend engineer with 9 years of experience designing reliable, observable distributed systems. I love turning fuzzy problems into simple, well-tested software and helping teams grow.

Currently focused on Rust, event-driven architectures and developer tooling.

work.name: Nimbus Analytics

Introduced tracing and SLO-based alerting across 30 services.
Mentored 5 engineers, two of them promoted to senior.
